newsitem.title: ITALY: Giribaldi raises stake in Italy's Cofide.
newsitem.headline: Giribaldi raises stake in Italy's Cofide.

text.p: Monaco-based businessman Luigi Giribaldi has raised his stake in Carlo De Benedetti's financial holding company Cofide to 15.86 percent, Italian bourse authority Consob said in a statement.
His stake, held through the Monaco-based Banque du Gothard, rose from 14.3 percent in the week ending October 30.
Last month Giribaldi said he had taken just over a two percent stake in De Benedetti's industrial holding company Cir which is controlled by Cofide.
De Benedetti is the main shareholder in Cofide.
